annotations.title: List a lambda in the showcase

description: Lists a lambda in the installation's showcase, where anybody browsing it finds it, with a title, a line about it and a picture - or changes its entry, or takes it out. The picture is named, never sent: a file the person attached (its id), or a picture of the newest version's resources ('resources/web/preview.png') - PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. Only when the user asks for it: showcasing is the owner's choice. The REST API does the same (platform_guide, showcase).

attachment.description: The picture, by the id of a file the person attached; left out, the one it has is kept.

description.description: A line or two about what it does, for people browsing.

remove.description: Take it out of the showcase instead.

resource.description: The picture, as a file of the newest version's resources instead.

title.description: What it is called there, in the language of its pages.

name: showcase
title: List a lambda in the showcase
